# GitHub Copilot instructions

`AGENTS.md` is authoritative for shared agent roles, escalation, cost policy,
deterministic validation, architecture, safety, testing, and change discipline.
`docs/CONTRIBUTING.md` is authoritative for Conventional Commit types, scopes,
breaking-change markers, and version-bump thresholds.

Copilot is a specialist/escalation agent in this repository. Do not treat
Copilot as the default implementation agent, and do not invoke additional
paid or cloud agents for routine coverage.

## Versioning and changelog

- If you change any code, you MUST run `./scripts/bump-version.sh`.
- `./scripts/bump-version.sh` is the single source of truth for:
  - version numbers across the repo
  - CHANGELOG updates
- Follow `AGENTS.md` for mode semantics: `auto` (and `auto --allow-dirty`)
  rewrites version files and **does not commit or tag**; `patch` / `minor` /
  `major` and an explicit version argument also commit and create an annotated
  `vX.Y.Z` tag.
- If you are changing `scripts/bump-version.sh` itself, test that script in a
  throwaway git repo as described in `AGENTS.md`.
- If changes do not require a version bump, explicitly state why in the PR
  description.

## PR acceptance criteria

- CI must pass.
- PR must include:
  - updated versions (as produced by bump-version.sh)
  - updated CHANGELOG entry
- If no version bump is required, the PR description must state why those
  artifacts are unchanged.

## PR title format

PR titles generated by Copilot **must** follow Conventional Commits:

- Format: `<type>(optional-scope): short description`
- Type must be lowercase: `feat`, `fix`, `update`, `docs`, `style`, `refactor`, `perf`, `test`, `build`, `ci`, `chore`, `revert`
- Scope (if used) must be lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens/underscores: `[a-z0-9_-]+`
- Prefer a documented scope from `docs/CONTRIBUTING.md` when it applies: `installer`, `kernel`, `btrfs`, `zfs`, `rocm`, `plasma`, `blender`, `ci`, `commit-lint`, `workflows`, `scripts`, `bump-version`, `tests`, `docs`, `changelog`, `readme`, `security`, `phase2`, `commits`
- Description must be 1–100 characters long (not including the type/scope prefix)

**CI enforcement**: The commit-lint workflow will **reject** PR titles from Copilot that contain:

- **Generic automation phrases**: "Codex pull request", "Copilot updates", "AI-generated changes", "autogenerated fix"
- **Vague phrases**: "update code", "fix issue", "apply changes", "make changes" (complete phrases)
- **Standalone vague words**: "update", "fix", "change" when used alone as the entire description

Good examples:

- `feat(installer): add validation for preserved kernels`
- `fix(ci): handle empty PR title from automation`
- `docs: clarify ROCm prerequisites`
- `feat(rocm): add ROCm 7.1 support`
- `docs: update codebase documentation` (specific context provided)

Bad examples (will be rejected):

- `fix: Codex-generated pull request` (generic automation phrase)
- `feat: Copilot updates` (generic automation phrase)
- `feat: update code` (vague phrase)
- `update: fix issue` (vague phrase)
- `docs: update` (standalone vague word)
- `FEAT: uppercase type` (wrong case)
